AlertsPage.description: One page of alerts, by name, and how many match in all.

history.description:
The turns before this one. The service keeps no session, so the panel
sends the thread back; without it the model answered a follow-up with
no idea what came before it.

DrilldownBody.description:
What a caller may ask a page for. An absent body asks for the first page
of the whole result, in the metric's own order.

EnabledRequest.description: Turning a rule on or off names the revision it expects to change.

folder.description: The folder's id, or null for none.

name.description: Trimmed, then 1 to 64 characters, unique ignoring case.

NotificationsPage.description: One page of a rule's notifications, newest first.

Operator.description: How the observed value is compared with the threshold.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem+json. `context` varies by error category.

dataset.description: The dataset this record belongs to, which must already be declared.

to.description: The name it should answer to from now on.

RuleDraft.description: A rule as an administrator writes it.

column.description:
The result column holding the number, by the `as_name` the metric
gives it.

destination.description: The configured destination the notification goes to.

expected_revision.description:
The revision this write expects to replace. Required to change an
alert that exists; not sent when creating one.

interval_secs.description: How often to check, in seconds.

name.description: What the alert is called, as people read it: up to 200 characters.

range.description:
The window the metric is run over, as `run_metric` takes it. Omit it
to run the metric unbounded.

threshold.description: The number the value is compared with.

RuleResponse.description: A rule as a reader is shown it.

id.description: The handle every other operation takes.

StateResponse.description:
What the latest checks left: when, what was found, and whether the
last valid check saw the condition met.

last_outcome.description: `breach`, `no_breach` or `unknown`; absent before the first check.

SummaryResponse.description: One alert as a listing shows it.

tags.description:
Every tag the dashboard carries from now on, each trimmed to 1 to 32
characters, at most 10; `[]` clears them.

Turn.description:
One turn of the conversation so far. The reader's panel keeps the thread
and sends it back, because the service stores no session.

role.description: `user` or `assistant`; anything else is dropped before the call.

info.description: Raw-data ingestion under a static instance token, and the metric, widget and dashboard definitions the portal's custom pages read. The API Gateway mounts this service at /api/v3.
